reviews.title: Used to be awesome. Now, not
reviews.text:
This is one of two apps I have ever paid for because I loved the layout and UI of it. I’ve been using this app for 6 or 7 years and it’s been great. But now I can’t stand it. The UI used to be wonderful and now is trash, the update deleted my previously saved events (I re-added them but the fact that it deleted important dates is BS), can’t edit/crop the images how you used to be able to do… at this point I am just going to parrot what the other recent comments have already stated, so I’ll just leave it there.

Tl;dr: this app used to be awesome and was exactly what I had been wanting and I loved it so much that I ended up buying the app outright. Now I hate it and am looking at alternatives.

reviews.title: Inaccurate day count
reviews.text: I put in a date that’s about 33 days away. I chose to exclude weekends in the settings and the preview showed that the date was 23 days away. Clicked the check mark and then it automatically changed to 28 days away. No matter how many times I change it, the app continues to display an incorrect number of days and I’m not sure how it arrived at that number. Kind of defeats the purpose of the app if it can’t accurately count down the days.

reviews.title: App was great! 6.0 Not So.
reviews.text:
I have used this app and paid the premium price for years. I have ADHD and calendars are distracting for me (sounds silly it’s the truth) so I love being able to us this app, which shows the very next event that you have coming up, to keep track of what to focus on next without getting distracted by too many future events. It’s been very helpful!

6.0 the basic functions of the app are still essentially the same, so I am still giving the app some time for me to get used to the new update.

However, in the way that I use the app, the 6.0 update has made some changes that are less helpful. It is now more clicks/taps to edit an events ‘Category’ (was three, is now six), and it seems to have changed my appointments, which had set times, to ‘All Day’, which I was able to easily fix by turning off All Day, but it does still feel like a bug. And, as other reviews have noted, the previous aesthetic of the app was more pleasing to the eye and had more information about each Counter on the List View page, and the new update is not nice to look at and has less information than before.

I have a feeling that I will stop paying the subscription this year, but hopefully an option to go back to the previous aesthetic can be added. If that is added, then I will keep my subscription.

reviews.text:
In 6.0 the list view of counters the counted time and the start date of the counter is tiny. It no longer shows the start time of the center. There actual name of the counter is smaller. Huge amounts of blank space around the actual content. The previous design made the counted time of the counter the largest element. Now it’s the selected background of the counter.

I have never cared about the backgrounds, always set it to black (which was annoying because it always defaults to something). Now the stuff I care about is tiny and the dumbest feature is the app is front and center.

3 stars from me until this is fixed.
